description.narrative: The Executive Committee of the Multilateral Fund for the Implementation of the Montreal Protocol, at its 90th Meeting, approved stage II of the HCFC phase-out management plan (HPMP) for Benin to achieve the complete phase-out of HCFC consumption by the 1 January 2030. In addition to the complet phase-out of HCFC consumption, HCFCs would not be imported after that date, except for those allowed for a servicing tail between 2030 and 2040. Therefore, the 15.47 ODP tonnes of HCFCs remaining will be phase-out during the stage II. During this tranche, the Government of Benin should submit: (i) A detailed description of the regulatory and policy framework in place to implement measures for the period 2030#2040; (ii) The expected annual HCFC consumption in Benin for the period 2030#2040.
